qEn: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
qHi: किस ग्रह को लाल ग्रह के रूप में जाना जाता है?
explainEn: Mars appears red due to iron oxide prevalent on its surface.

qEn: What is the national flower of India?
qHi: भारत का राष्ट्रीय फूल कौन सा है?
explainEn: The lotus flower (Nelumbo nucifera) is the national flower of India.

qEn: Which city is known as the Pink City of India?
qHi: भारत के किस शहर को गुलाबी शहर कहा जाता है?
explainEn: Jaipur is famously known as the Pink City due to the distinct color of its buildings.

qEn: Who wrote the Indian National Anthem, 'Jana Gana Mana'?
qHi: भारत का राष्ट्रीय गान 'जन गण मन' किसने लिखा था?
explainEn: Rabindranath Tagore originally composed the national anthem in Bengali.
sourceHint: Constitution of India Constituent Assembly Debates

qEn: Which is the longest river in India?
qHi: भारत की सबसे लंबी नदी कौन सी है?
explainEn: The Ganga is the longest river originating within India, spanning over 2,500 kilometers.

qEn: In which state is the Kaziranga National Park located?
qHi: काजीरंगा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान किस राज्य में स्थित है?
explainEn: Kaziranga National Park is located in the state of Assam and hosts the world's largest population of great Indian one-horned rhinoceroses.
sourceHint: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, PIB

qEn: What is the chemical symbol for gold?
qHi: सोने का रासायनिक प्रतीक क्या है?
explainEn: Au stands for aurum, the Latin word for gold.

qEn: Which classical dance form originates from Kerala?
qHi: कौन सा शास्त्रीय नृत्य रूप केरल से उत्पन्न हुआ है?
explainEn: Kathakali is a major form of classical Indian dance known for its elaborate costumes and makeup, originating in Kerala.
sourceHint: Ministry of Culture, Government of India

qEn: Which Indian state is the largest producer of coffee?
qHi: कौन सा भारतीय राज्य कॉफी का सबसे बड़ा उत्पादक है?
explainEn: Karnataka accounts for over 70 percent of India's total coffee production, primarily grown in the hill districts of Kodagu, Chikkamagaluru, and Hassan.

qEn: The classical dance form of Kathakali originated in which state?
qHi: शास्त्रीय नृत्य शैली कथकली की उत्पत्ति किस राज्य में हुई थी?
explainEn: Kathakali is a major form of classical Indian dance that originated in the southern state of Kerala, known for its elaborate makeup and costumes.
sourceHint: Centre for Cultural Resources and Training (CCRT)

qEn: Who wrote the famous novel 'Godan'?
qHi: प्रसिद्ध उपन्यास 'गोदान' किसने लिखा था?
explainEn: 'Godan' is a Hindi novel by Munshi Premchand, widely regarded as one of the greatest Hindi novels of modern Indian literature.

qEn: Which chemical element has the symbol 'Fe'?
qHi: किस रासायनिक तत्व का प्रतीक 'Fe' है?
explainEn: The symbol 'Fe' comes from the Latin word for iron, 'ferrum'.

qEn: In which year did India conduct its first nuclear test, code-named Smiling Buddha?
qHi: भारत ने किस वर्ष अपना पहला परमाणु परीक्षण किया था, जिसका कूट नाम स्माइलिंग बुद्धा था?
explainEn: India conducted its first successful nuclear bomb test on May 18, 1974, at the Pokhran Test Range in Rajasthan.
sourceHint: Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India

qEn: Which mountain range separates the Indian subcontinent from the Tibetan Plateau?
qHi: कौन सी पर्वत श्रृंखला भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप को तिब्बती पठार से अलग करती है?
explainEn: The Himalayas form a mountain range in Asia separating the plains of the Indian subcontinent from the Tibetan Plateau.

qEn: What is the standard unit of electrical resistance?
qHi: विद्युत प्रतिरोध की मानक इकाई क्या है?
explainEn: The ohm is the SI derived unit of electrical resistance, named after the German physicist Georg Ohm.

qEn: Which gas do plants absorb from the atmosphere for photosynthesis?
qHi: पौधे प्रकाश संश्लेषण के लिए वायुमंडल से कौन सी गैस अवशोषित करते हैं?
explainEn: Plants take in carbon dioxide during photosynthesis to produce food and oxygen.

qEn: How many permanent members are there in the United Nations Security Council?
qHi: संयुक्त राष्ट्र सुरक्षा परिषद में कितने स्थायी सदस्य हैं?
explainEn: There are 5 permanent members in the UNSC: China, France, Russia, the UK, and the US.

qEn: Which vitamin is primarily obtained by the human body from exposure to sunlight?
qHi: मानव शरीर को मुख्य रूप से धूप के संपर्क में आने से कौन सा विटामिन प्राप्त होता है?
explainEn: Sunlight prompts human skin to synthesize Vitamin D.

qEn: Which musical instrument is associated with Pandit Ravi Shankar?
qHi: पंडित रविशंकर किस वाद्य यंत्र से जुड़े हैं?
explainEn: Pandit Ravi Shankar was a legendary Indian musician known for popularizing the sitar globally.
sourceHint: Ministry of Culture, Government of India

qEn: What is the standard boiling point of pure water at sea level in Celsius?
qHi: समुद्र तल पर शुद्ध पानी का मानक क्वथनांक (Boiling Point) सेल्सियस में कितना होता है?
explainEn: Pure water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at standard atmospheric pressure.

qEn: Who wrote the famous Sanskrit play 'Abhijnanashakuntalam'?
qHi: प्रसिद्ध संस्कृत नाटक 'अभिज्ञानशाकुंतलम्' के रचयिता कौन हैं?
explainEn: Kalidasa is widely recognized as one of ancient India's greatest classical Sanskrit poets and playwrights, known for Abhijnanashakuntalam.

qEn: In which city is the headquarters of the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) located?
qHi: भारतीय अंतरिक्ष अनुसंधान संगठन (ISRO) का मुख्यालय किस शहर में स्थित है?
explainEn: ISRO headquarters is situated in Bengaluru, Karnataka, where policy formulation, program management, and major research activities are directed.

qEn: Which classical dance form originates from the state of Kerala and is known for elaborate makeup and colorful costumes?
qHi: कौन सा शास्त्रीय नृत्य रूप केरल राज्य से उत्पन्न हुआ है और विस्तृत मेकअप और रंगीन वेशभूषा के लिए जाना जाता है?
explainEn: Kathakali is a major form of classical Indian dance distinct for its vibrant storytelling, heavy facial makeup, and elaborate costumes.
sourceHint: Ministry of Culture, Government of India

qEn: Which constitutional article in India provides for the establishment of the Supreme Court?
qHi: भारत में कौन सा संवैधानिक अनुच्छेद सर्वोच्च न्यायालय की स्थापना का प्रावधान करता है?
explainEn: Article 124 of the Constitution of India deals with the establishment and constitution of the Supreme Court.

qEn: What is the chemical symbol for the element Gold?
qHi: स्वर्ण (Gold) तत्व का रासायनिक प्रतीक क्या है?
explainEn: The chemical symbol for gold is Au, which comes from the Latin word 'aurum', meaning 'shining dawn'.

qEn: Which wildlife sanctuary in Assam is famous as the primary habitat for the Indian rhinoceros?
qHi: असम का कौन सा वन्यजीव अभयारण्य भारतीय गैंडे के प्राथमिक निवास स्थान के रूप में प्रसिद्ध है?
explainEn: Kaziranga National Park in Assam hosts two-thirds of the world's great one-horned rhinoceroses and is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

qEn: What type of financial instrument is a Treasury Bill (T-Bill) issued in India?
qHi: भारत में जारी किया जाने वाला ट्रेजरी बिल (T-Bill) किस प्रकार का वित्तीय साधन है?
explainEn: Treasury bills are short-term money market instruments issued by the Government of India to meet short-term liquidity requirements.
